from scipy import stats

# Load data

# Aggregate predator and small fish productivity by reef-year
pred = df[df.trophic_level > 4.0].groupby(['id_reef', 'year'])['prod'].sum().rename('predator_prod')
small = df[df.trophic_level <= 2.0].groupby(['id_reef', 'year'])['prod'].sum().rename('small_prod')
agg = pd.concat([pred, small], axis=1).fillna(0).reset_index()

# Compute 25th percentile threshold for predator production
threshold = np.percentile(agg['predator_prod'], 25)
agg['low_pred'] = agg['predator_prod'] < threshold

# Attach next-year small fish production
agg['next_small_prod'] = agg.groupby('id_reef')['small_prod'].shift(-1)
merged = agg.dropna(subset=['next_small_prod'])

# Deliverable 1: Show sample of the aggregated table
print("Threshold for low predator production (25th percentile):", threshold)
print("Aggregated predator and small_prod with low_pred flag (first 10 rows):")
print(agg[['id_reef', 'year', 'predator_prod', 'small_prod', 'low_pred']].head(10))

# Deliverable 2: Summary statistics of next-year small_prod by low_pred flag

print("\nSummary of next-year small_prod by predator status:")
print(summary)

# Deliverable 3: Paired tests by reef
per_reef = merged.groupby(['id_reef', 'low_pred'])['next_small_prod'].mean().unstack()
per_reef = per_reef.dropna()
low_vals = per_reef[True]
nonlow_vals = per_reef[False]
t_stat, t_p = stats.ttest_rel(low_vals, nonlow_vals)
w_stat, w_p = stats.wilcoxon(low_vals, nonlow_vals)
diff = low_vals - nonlow_vals
d_cohen = diff.mean() / diff.std(ddof=1)
print(f"\nPaired t-test: t = {t_stat:.3f}, p = {t_p:.3e}")
print(f"Wilcoxon signed-rank test: W = {w_stat:.3f}, p = {w_p:.3e}")
